                            View "public.v_check"
  Column  |  Type   | Collation | Nullable | Default | Storage | Description 
----------+---------+-----------+----------+---------+---------+-------------
 order_id | bigint  |           |          |         | plain   | 
 qty      | integer |           |          |         | plain   | 
View definition:
 SELECT orders.order_id,
    orders.qty
   FROM orders
  WHERE orders.qty > 1;
Triggers:
    v_check_ins INSTEAD OF INSERT ON v_check FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION view_ins_fn()
Options: check_option=local
